candidates.change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 5 ether, altering when fallback accepts and updates pastBlockTime and potentially when funds are transferred.
Remove the timestamp ordering check so pastBlockTime is always updated on accepted payments, changing recorded pastBlockTime behavior.
Change the assignment to set pastBlockTime to block.number instead of block.timestamp, altering the stored value exposed by the public getter.
Always transfer contract balance to sender (remove the if condition), changing when funds are drained and possibly affecting future pastBlockTime observations via state changes due to transfers.
Invert the if condition so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0, altering transfer timing and thus observable balances after calls.
